title: S6 Gateway Telemetry Profile
description: Gateway-neutral telemetry frame profile mirrored from TelemetryFrame in src/lib.rs (the code is the authoritative contract). Field names and value domains match the Rust validator exactly. Two code-enforced rules are not expressible here and remain enforced only in code: identifiers must additionally be free of leading/trailing whitespace and control characters, and payload_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of the base64-decoded payload bytes. tests/schema_contract.rs fails CI if this document drifts from the Rust types.

payload_base64.description: Standard base64 encoding of 1 to 1048576 payload bytes.
